The received filter is thinner than the original and it came with a metal frame around the entire filter, not just on the long sides as shown in the photo. I was able to modify it by cutting a piece out of the
middle of the short sides of the frame. I was therefore able to bend the filter to enable it to be inserted into the holder. The modification only took a few minutes and I am happy because I finally have a new filter to use. The next time I need a new filter, I will call the company first to verify what I want to order. I would recommend the filter to anyone whose replacement part is no longer manufactured.

product_title: Great Northern 7975 Frosty-Keg, Stainless Steel Kegerator Beer Dispenser Refrigerator
review_headline: Good product, decent parts - small CO2 tank.
review_body: I've only had this running for about a week, and so far, so good. I only really have 2 complaints.  First is the size of the CO2 tank that ships with this model is too small.  It's only a 2.5 lbs. tank, and the standard is 5 lbs.  So when I went to exchange the tank for a new one (since I couldn't find a place to fill it) I had to purchase a new tank for another $100.  Had I know that, I would have spent the money up-front with the purchase of the kegerator.  The second complaint is the directions that came with it.  This is my first kegerator, and I knew nothing going in... the directions were very little help, and the amount of extra parts only confused the issue.  But, it's running, and the beer is cold, so that makes everything all better.

product_title: Granite Grabbers Dishwasher Mounting Brackets
review_body: This product works perfect!  Must follow the directions carefully to achieve a good bond.  I have had no issues since installing these, my dishwasher is now rock steady.

product_title: Koolatron WC04 Compact Thermoelectric 4-Bottle Wine Cooler
review_headline: Stopped cooling in less than one month.
review_body: The lights come on and the fan still runs, but the unit stopped cooling after less than one month.  I should have trusted the other overwhelmingly negative reviews.

product_title: Danby DAR195BL 1.8 cu.ft. All Refrigerator -  Black
review_headline: Noisy, runs constantly -> replaced, and now works well
review_body:
Oh sure, this refrigerator keeps things inside cold, but has the following major problems:

(1) It's excessively noisy. The first day we plugged it in, it sounded just fine (low hum). By the second day, a slight whine/ringing had developed. On the third night, I had trouble falling asleep because the whine/ringing had grown in such volume that it was annoying laying in bed with the refrigerator in the adjacent (master) bathroom (open doorway... but still, over 40' away in a hallway with a 90 degree bend).

(2) It's constantly running. I've observed the compressor running for 1+ hour straight at a setting of 6/10 (10 being coldest) 2 hours after the refrigerator was last opened, when it only had 2 small bottles inside of it. This seems unusual to me.

Oh sure, I've read the reviews and it seems like we might have received a \\"bad\\" unit. We will try to exchange this unit for a \\"good\\" one... but at the end of the day, this is just a major hassle.

UPDATE - 1/8/13 -

Received a replacement refrigerator yesterday (Amazon Prime is amazing!). We got this unit set up and running (after the recommended 2-3 hour wait) and 24 hours later, I can safely say that this unit operates significantly differently (i.e. BETTER) than the original unit. This unit runs quieter (no high-pitch ringing... hopefully this isn't something that will start in the future), and the compressor on this unit actually cycles on/off in a reasonable fashion (about 5-10 minutes on every 30-50 minutes).

I am now upgrading my review to 3 stars (from 1 star). The refrigerator now works to our satisfaction. However, I don't know if I can recommend this refrigerator, due to the chance of receiving a bad unit, and the hassle of going through the replacement process (although I give Amazon kudos for correcting the issue very quickly).

product_title: Whirlpool Washer Motor Coupling # 285753A
review_body:
I purchased a used washer and wasn't too shocked when it didn't work. We found out that this part was the problem so we ordered it in hopes of salvaging this machine.
The part is a tight fit, but it's supposed to be. You could buy the one with the metal insert, but as hard as this was to slip into place, the metal would have made it impossible.
I've had the part on the washer for about 2 weeks now and It's worked flawlessly.

product_title: Pug Dishwasher Magnet (Black)
review_body: Terrific little useful magnet.

product_title: 14 Lbs.Top Load Portable Washer Color: Platinum
review_body: I bought this through another dealer. There are very few reviews about this product. The overall machine is decent, but compared to older Avanti models, I am disappointed. I had a smaller washer that actually had wheels in the front and back. Sadly, this machine only has wheels in the back. This makes it extremely difficult to get to the sink. I had to purchase a dolly to put it on to make it easier to move. Not sure what Avanti was thinking.

product_title: Amana 3.5 -Cubic Foot Front Load Washer, NFW7300WW, White
review_body:
We've seem to have had issues with this washer ever since we bought it. Almost certainly first to go was the rubber seal on the inside of the door. I should've listened to the negative reviews before I bought it. If the review is often high, I will disregard the lower reviews as a minority of disgruntled customers. Well guess what, I am a part of the minority too now. lol.

So basically overall I rated this a 3, I will breakdown why:

First for the price, the free delivery, and the free installation, I still can't go wrong with my decision. Add to the fact that this has a high loading capacity versus other similar brands and models and that my issues were resolvable (minus the time wasted on the phone with the warranty people and with service calls), I'd say I can't rate this below a 3.

The only thing that I can suggest is to get a big warranty on this. I think that there is good wisdom in that.

product_title: Koolatron Compressor Fridge - Silver
review_body: This item arrived with several dents in it and the freezer takes up too much space in an already tiny refrigerator.  It is not even nessesary to have a freezer in this because it does not even fit anything anyhow.!!!!!!

product_title: GE PFE29PSDSS Profile 28.6 Cu. Ft. Stainless Steel French Door Refrigerator - Energy Star
review_body:
I finally gave in and decided to replace the \\"came with the home\\" GE side by side that was still chugging away since 1998. Wow! That GE was turn of the century and the ice maker and water dispenser still worked. There was no question that only brand that could replace that GE was another GE.

Going from a side by side to a french door is unbelievable! I love the space in this refrigerator! Even though the ice maker is in the door, there are still three shelves (albeit two of them are rather narrow) placed there to still maximize the space. This refrigerator was thoughtfully designed and is easily configured to accommodate just about any sized container or item. The multiple shelves are easily raised or lowered. One shelf can retract part way to allow for extremely oversized or very tall items to fit. There are two ample drawers for either veg or fruit. I also like the temperature controlled drawer that can be used for a variety of items.

The controls on this refrigerator are operated through a few buttons and touch screen interaction. I found the menus rather easy to navigate and it didn't take too much digging to get to key features that need adjusting. I love the fact that I can place a water bottle, press an auto fill and walk away. The screen will even display the amount of water dispensed into a container in ml, oz. or cups. There is also a precise fill feature that will let you select an exact amount of water to be dispensed. This is a great feature for baking/recipes!

After the refrigerator was installed, I enabled the turbo cool for both the refrigerator and the freezer. A few hours later, the temps were dropping and everything was getting well cooled.

The unit is incredibly quiet and I can honestly say that I love this refrigerator. I am so impressed that I'm writing a review for it! I don't know why I waited so long to replace the old one, but I'm thrilled with this new GE. The quality and thoughtful design are fantastic! I can't recommend this unit highly enough!

product_title: Frigidaire F30WV16EC 30-Inch Under-Cabinet Range Hood, Stainless Steel
review_headline: Easy to Install, Great Value for the $$
review_body: Looked at quite a few stainless range hoods.  You can certainly pay a lot more for a unit than you will for this one - but why?  The quality of the unit is fine, the fan is not loud and it moves enough air to pull out all the cooking fumes we generate.  All in all, a great value for the $$.

product_title: Luma Comfort IMPC-2800S Portable Clear Ice Maker
review_headline: Right out of the box, does not work!
review_body:
Did this Chinese made product ever get turned on and checked at the factory? I say NO. Did not make any ice from day one. Tried it at least three times. The damn thing just went through it's cycle and the LED blinked at me. Felt like drop kicking it across the room. Instead, I shipped it back.

So, Amazon lost money on this crap. Lesson learned? How about don't sell ANY products that have zero quality control.

So, I gotta ask, is there a well built ice maker for home use that is not expensive? (Under $500)

product_title: Supco SUPCO RIM300 ICEMAKER REPLACEMENT KIT
review_body:
This icemaker was a reasonably priced replacement to the icemaker in my 90's era GE profile refrigerator. It is not nearly as substantial as the one it replaced. The lower bracket did not line up with the screw hole in the refrigerator and could not be used. The bar which is supposed to raise up as the ice fills the bin gets stuck in the ice; so we just turn it off manually when it is full. It was a bargain compared to the price of a new refrigerator.
Update 2012: the ice maker worked for about a year. The refrigerator is old, so I'm not spending any more on repairs.

product_title: Broan Evolution QP4 Series QP430SS 30" High Performance Under-Cabinet Range Hood 4 Halogen with Theater-Style Transitions Easy-to-clean Advanced Heat Sentry: Stainless
review_headline: It's fairly quiet, but awful to install, and operate
review_body: I bought it because it claimed to be quiet. It is fairly quiet, and I do like it now that we managed to install it. It was very difficult to install, and once installed, it slopes down towards the back a bit. The controls are also a bit difficult to figure out, takes repeated looking up in the manual just to figure the lights. If there is a momentary power outage, the lights have to be reset. it seems to default back to the factory settings, which leaves a night light setting on all the time. So, despite the fact that it is quiet, I really can't recommend it.

product_title: LG WM3455HS 24 Front Load Compact Washer/Dryer Combo , 2.7 cu. ft. Capacity - Silver
review_body: I have one in my rental apartment.  This is the worst product I have ever encountered.  You cannot be serious that someone would invent a washer that does not actually perform a drying function.  It literally takes 4 hours to dry...then I have to iron for another hour.  After a long spin cycle, it hardly takes that long for it to air dry...maybe just a few more hours.  Insane does not describe how terrible this product is.  I feel bad for anyone that actually paid money for this. Crazy that a space saving appliance is actually a waste of space.

product_title: Maytag Maxima EcoConserve MHW7000XG 27 Front-Load Steam Washer 4.3 cu. ft. Capacity, Cosmetallic
review_headline: Nice washer with critical design flaw
review_body: I've used this new washer for about two months and, initially I was happy, but I'm regretting my purchase.  There is a design flaw where if you're using liquid detergent, it immediately leaks in to the drum by spilling out on the inside part of the door.  This wouldn't be an issue for most clothes but it can stain delicate fabrics. I have some white shirts and bed sheets that now have a faint dark spots where the detergent came in contact directly.     Anyway, I thought it was something wrong with my unit but apparently, repair person has confirmed that it's just the way they are designed.  So unless you like getting your good clothes ruined, don't buy this model.

product_title: Broan Allure 36-Inch Under Cabinet Mount Range Hood
review_headline: Nice addition to my newly remodeled kitchen
review_body: My husband installed this easily in a couple hours. I love the two light settings, the fan isn't too loud on high, but if you're looking for whisper soft, keep looking. It looks modern, and suits me nicely.

product_title: Broan 30-Inch Allure Range Hood
review_body: This hood looks good, but the quality control is lacking.  It arrived without the parts bag which entailed a trip to Home Depot for extra parts for installation.  The fan also makes a ting, ting, ting sound on low and a TING, TING, TING  sound on high.  The motor is very quiet but who cares now.  I will try to find where the blade is hitting, but I should not have to do that.

product_title: SUNFLOWER 3-D Stove / Burner Covers Set of 4 *NEW*
review_body: I love the design but I thought it was more sturdy..it's ceramic and it's delicate ..you cannot put thing on top of it because it will chip

product_title: Danby 120 Can Beverage Center, Stainless Steel DBC120BLS
review_headline: Horrid experience.  Item not at fault.
review_body: Horrific experience with vendor, as the item box came very damaged, as was the actual item due to poor care by vendor and potentially shipper, as well.  The item box was so damaged, it could not be used when returned to vendor.  Like many other posters have indicated, the item may be fine but due to the poor care of the vendor and potentially shipper as well, the item was damaged.  The beverage center was ultra noisy at times, as it sounded like it was about to break. It began fairly quiet enough and within 2 days, it began screaming at us (very noisy). The door was damaged (dented).  The actual shipping box was in bad shape as well but the product box was undeniably horrific (pictures were taken for proof just in case).  The vendor also threatened to re-charge my account the full amount of the product, as they could not properly read the UPS tracking system, when in fact they did get their damaged product back within the required time frame (which the UPS tracking showed).  Overall, awful experience. Product very poorly cared for by vendor in my opinion.  Product itself actually looked fine.  I will not use vendor again.  Maybe worst vendor i've dealt with in several years.

product_title: LG WM2140CW 27 Front Load Washer with 3.5 cu. ft. Large Capacity
review_headline: Best Buy for Basic Front Loader
review_body: I'm amazed at how this machine can compensate for bulky heavy loads like multiple  bathroom rugs that threw my prior machine totally out of balance.  As for cleaning,  it does a good job with very quiet operation.  As for any musty smell - there isn't any.  However, using too much soap is a common  mistake which could lead to buildup and possible odor issues.  Or a home may simply have  a bad water smell which could be more noticeable in a front loader than a top loader because  it isn't vented as well.  I recall the rotten egg smell (sulpher dioxide) of the water in Florida   when I lived there years ago.  You came out of the shower smelling bad.  Note monthly cleanings are typical for most all front loaders which use little water.  There  simply isn't the same volume of water used in top loaders which tend to flush out both grime, as  well as the overuse of laundry detergents, softners, etc.  Just check out the high ratings this machine has received on other web surveys and professional  publications like Consumer Reports.

product_title: Whirlpool 4396841T PUR Push Button Side-by-Side Refrigerator Water Filter, 3-Pack
review_body: it does what it is supposed to do.  I only have issues with it at the beginning when I put it in.  A lot of fuzzy fluid and air comes through for a couple of days after changing a new one.  Also I think the filter could go longer than the 6 months the refrigerator programs it to go.  But I have not felt risky enough to try it.

product_title: Whirlpool GSF26C4EXY
review_body: So far we are happy with our purchase, very roomy inside. The only thing is that plastic inside isn't as durable on the doors. Ice maker is a little too loud when there is no ice in the bin, but after few fills we don't hear it at all. We are happy with our purchase and would recomend it to a friend.

product_title: Avanti WD31EC Table Top Thermoelectric Water Cooler
review_headline: it work like a CHAMP great for the prices
review_body: need one to sit on top of a table and small, it does the job great, have to read the setup and had no problem at all. just one thing small the machine, it don't hold a alot of water to cool down.

product_title: Mini Portable Countertop Spin Dryer
review_headline: WOW!! Didn't expect to be so awesome!!
review_body:
I bought this spin dryer and received it today. I didn't expect it to be as big as it was, but i am extremely happy with it's size. It can dry more clothes then i expecedt. I first tested it out my soaking a long sleeve shirt in water, didn't wring it out or anything. And placed it straight in the spin dryer soaking wet for the recommended time which is 1 minute. OH MY GOSH, my shirt is about 95% dry its amazing. I was thinking about purchasing a mini tumble dryer to go with this spin dryer and wonderwash. But glad i didnt. I use the Easy Dry portable clothes dryer, and everything is perfect. I can do my laundry at home and don't need to worry about quarters, or using a public machine.
IF ANYONE IS THINKING ABOUT PURCHASING THIS SPIN DRYER GO FOR IT!!
100% RECOMMENDED AND WORTH EVERY PENNY!

product_title: SPT Countertop Dishwasher
review_body: shipped in two days, but after opening the box noticed the sick adopter was broken. emailed the company and they sent out a new adoptor with in the week.  hooked it all up and it works great. cycle time is a bit long, but it's super quite.  (tip: turn on hot water and let it run hot before connecting dish washer before each wash.)

product_title: LG : DLE2101W 27 Electric Dryer with 7.3 cu. ft. Capacity White
review_headline: DO NOT BUY AN LG DRYER!
review_body: LG IS A NEW COMPANY ON THE MARKET!  I am reporting that you will NOT have any longevity with their dryers!! Had a Maytag or Whirlpool for 15+ years....well you won't have an LG for very long...the drum cracks or seperates (cheap quality metal) and the felt liner will wear and your clothes will be ruined.  We've had ours 5 years and had to replace the drum twice (at 200.00 a pop) and those enegry efficient savings????  Well they are out the window after part bills like that!  DON'T BE FOOLED!!!  YOU WILL NOT SAVE ANY MONEY IN THE LONG RUN....customer service is the pits!!  All you will hear is sorry....you're out a warranty. IT IS A CRYING SHAME!  Disposable washer and dryer for 1500.00 dollars?  Oh my!!

product_title: Frigidaire FGHN2844L 27.8 Cubic Foot French Door Refrigerator with SpaceWise Organization System and,
review_body: Bought this model in May and frost collects on the light fixture in the center  front of freezer and the seal at the same spot. Repair man made an adjustment and problem not fixed. Repairman returns with a new seal and now the freezer and evrything in it is frost covered barely frozen.He suggested i give the seal a couple of weeks the acclamate.I've removed everything because some froze soft and some didn't. Watery, icie and frosty in there.I guess we wait and see.  It's been about a year now since we bought the fridge. It took the repair man another visit to heat the seal on the freezer (this repairman new what he was doing  and the others were idiots) so the seal was complete and its been a great freezer since. although the ice holder will over fill some and when it is opened will drop some icecubes on the bottom of freezer and then you have to fish them out...it's not easy.

product_title: WB02T10461 General Electric GE Gas Range Grate Rubber Feet
review_body: I bought these to use on my Frigidaire 5 burner range.They work well & were a lot more reasonably priced then the actual ones. They eork great, no difference

product_title: Danby DAR195BL 1.8 cu.ft. All Refrigerator -  Black
review_body: This fridge is wonderful in every aspect cold silent with perfect size. Nice look to it has temperature control tested it out it froze a couple sodas not even at the max setting.

product_title: Broan 30W in. QP1 Under Cabinet Range Hood
review_body: This is a replacement for my microwave/hood, which is next to useless when removing greasy air from the kitchen.  This one looks very nice. When the fan is running at high speed, it creats a powerful suction, I can have a napkin to be sucked to the filter, that powerful.  The installation was a bit pain.  Once installed, it works great.  Wish I have done this earlier.

product_title: Amana 1.5 cu. ft. Over-the-Range Microwave, AMV1150VAW, White
review_body:
There is no brand name of the front of this appliance, which is nice because you can then pair it with your other appliances that may be a different brand. Which in my case was Whirlpool...just a note: Whirpool and Amana are one in the same.
I had it installed by a professional. I do not know if it was difficult to install. This is not a direct wire appliance, you will need an outlet in the cupboard above in order to plug it in.
So far no complaints. I have not had much time to use it...1 week since installation.

product_title: Danby 4.3 cu.ft. Compact Refrigerator
review_body: like the size and versatility of the item. very disapointed of the condition upon arrival. scratches and dinges all over outside of fridge. did not affect operation but sure looks bad.

product_title: Frigidaire Dishwasher Dispenser 154230104 Was 154230102
review_body: Usually when it comes to fixing things I'm better off letting the professionals do it. But, not this time!  I found this product was fairly easy to install. My dishwasher has been performing like a champ ever since!

product_title: Whirlpool GH7208XRS Gold 2.0 Cu. Ft. Stainless Steel Over-the-Range Microwave
review_headline: F7 HV SMPS Error after TWO years!
review_body: Purchased this microwave a little over two years ago. The microwave is aesthetically pleasing. We didn't use many of the features except for the microwave. The microwave worked great, but after two years we finally received the \\"F7 HV SMPS Error\\". It appears this is a common problem for this product. Just look it up online. It's very disappointing that such an expensive product fails after two years and for some in less time. I've owned $60 microwaves that lasted ten years or more! That's the last time I will purchase a Whirlpool product.

product_title: Builder's Best 110889 Thru-wall Dryer Vent Hood, 4", Galvanized
review_body: If you need a quality dryer vent hood, look no further. This one is very sturdy and I got it to replace a cheap ACE Hardware aluminum vent. It looks great on the side of my corrugated steel shed.

product_title: Dishwasher Door Gasket - 902894
review_body:
Almost replaced the old Maytag dishwasher just because to was leaking.
I added a temporary gasket over the existing gasket just to make sure it was coming from the door only.
Temporary gasket slowed it down to a few drips so I ordered the real gasket replacement from Amazon.
Its been on for a few weeks and is working fine. No leaks.

product_title: DCS CDU-365-N 36 Gas Cooktop 5 Sealed Dual Flow Burners, Continuous Grates and Stainless Steel
review_body: This cooktop is worth every penny.  Large pots of water boil so fast on the center burner, and there is plenty of room to use all the other burners at the same time.  I love this stove.

product_title: LG : LMX25984ST 36 24.7 cu. ft. French Door Refrigerator, Ice/Water Dispenser - Stainless Steel
review_body: The day after we got it I complained to store that it was the loudest refrigerator I have encountered in the last 35 years. They swap it out for another one and it has the same problem. I cannot believe that people who gave it a high rating were not disturbed by the whining of the fan motor when the compressor is on, which is 70% of the time. Factory tech is coming out in couple of days and we will see. If he says that this is normal we will return the refrigerator. The sound can be heard from 35 feet away easily.

product_title: SPT RF-330SS: 3.3 cu.ft. Compact Refrigerator (Stainless VCM)
review_body: Works well for my medical practice. Constant temps. Convenient size. Had it for a couple of months. No problems so far. Roomy on inside for vaccines.

product_title: Breathing Mobile Washer Classic - Portable Clothes Washing Machine - Handheld - Manual - Mobile Hand Powered Laundry Solution - Superior Materials and Construction
review_body: Used this as a volunteer in Tanzania with the Peace Corps. Let me tell you it literally saved my skin (on my knuckles). Yup it takes up space but it saves hours of ridiculous hand scrubbing when you find yourself in a 3rd world country with no running water. Left it to another volunteer who was thrilled to have it. By far one of my best splurges!

product_title: Wine Enthusiast Silent 28 Bottle Touchscreen Wine Refrigerator (Mirrored Door)
review_body: Very quiet, works very well.  Doesn't hold temperature when loosing power, but since it's more of a cellar than a standard fridge, it resets to its lowest setting (55'), which is perfect.  Only thing keeping it from 5 stars is not having wooden faces for the drawers.

product_title: Frigidaire : FSC23R5DSB Refrigerator
review_body: We purchased this fridge less than 5 years ago. After only 3 years we've had to have the ice machine repaired twice & it still doesn't shut off automatically. The ice over flows all over the place if we do not manually turn it off and then the ice falls down through the back and melts and leaks water all over the floor. The water lever on the outside of the door broke off and 2 of the drawer slides have broken. We are not hard on our appliances & for the $$ we paid for this appliance, I expected it to last a bit longer than it has. I am ready for a new one already & it will not be a Frigidaire. I also have a Frigidaire dishwasher that has been nothing but a pain. Big disappointment!

product_title: Maytag MHW8000AG Maxima 4.3 Cu. Ft. Gray Stackable With Steam Cycle Front Load Washer - Energy Star
review_body: We purchased the dryer and after about a week it starting making a loud banging noise even when clothes were not in it but they dried nicely.  We exchanged it for a new one.  After the second load it completely failed, it started up with a small humming sound and completely stopped.  We are replacing with a new brand.

product_title: NEW Replacement Part - Kenmore Electric Dryer Heating Element Part# PS344597
review_body: The part shipped fast and is, so far, working great. EDIT__ The part only lasted 6 months and when I contacted the company I got a very curt email back. Basically said \\"sorry 'bout your luck.\\"

product_title: Koolatron Coke Personal Mini Fridge
review_body:
This little fridge lasted all of 2 1/2 business days in my office (and the fan vents were not blocked). It was unplugged at the end of the day for the first two days. On the third day the fan suddenly stopped running after a few hours and the little green power light went dark.

On the plus side, it is an excellent white noise generator for an office environment. I don't think I'd want it running in my bedroom though.

Amazon was quick to send a replacement unit which will hopefully last much longer than the original!

product_title: AE-Select 137108100 Washer Drain Pump for Kenmore
review_body:
I called a appliance service place and was quoted a price of around $300 to replace this pump and another $200 to replace the belt. The washer quit working and leaked water on the floor. I went on the Internet and learned it could be this pump causing all of the problems. After further research, I found this drain pump could be used instead of the original model pump.

Replaced a water pump original number of 131724000 for a Kenmore stack washer/dryer combo model number 417.99812990

This pump worked perfectly and maybe even better than the original. It also fits the mounting area perfectly. It seems to empty the washer faster. I also decided to replace the belt and bought a belt for under $10 on Amazon and it fit perfectly. Needless to say, I am very pleased with Amazon.

product_title: Frigidaire Gallery Series : GLD2445RFS Full Console Dishwasher - White
review_body: We purchased this exact item at a local store. We are very pleased with the performance. We find the 3 wands do a fantastic job cleaning the dishes. We are also amazed at how much quieter this dishwasher is compared to our Quiet-MayTag we replaced. It really is a quiet machine in our opinion.   We like the interior coating. We like the sanitize option. We like the ONLY top or bottom cycle OPTION. It has many options for dish washing too... light, regular, pots/pans etc.   This dishwasher has many upgrades, and is comparable to a higher priced dishwasher, for a much lower cost. I have heard others who have chosen this model for the same reason--more for the money!  The only drawback we found, is the motor sits rather low. Unless you raise the legs up, it actually sits on the floor. We also noticed that the parts are not superior to the older model we discarded... but what isn't changed more to plastics these days than the expensive metals! Right!   It is made in Canada, and uses only 315 KWHours/year. We are all round pleased with this model.

product_title: Vinotemp 34-Bottle Touch Screen Wine Cooler
review_body: I bought this cooler for house to store wines. I love wines and I also like this stuff. It has a good design and easy to use. The customer care is also so good. This company is trustable!

product_title: GE JV347HWW 30 Under Cabinet Range Hood - White
review_body: I ordered this GE Under Cabinet Range Hood online and it was shipped pretty fast to me. Item looked brand new, well packaged even though without foam packaging, and it was very to install. Only issue was that the marked screw holes did not match my cabinet wooden frame since my cabinet dimensions are old, so I had to manually punch holes for the screws to align with the cabinet frames. Aside that, product works well and my wife loves it.

product_title: Danby 120 Can Beverage Center, Stainless Steel DBC120BLS
review_body:
I ordered it on Thursday and ended up receiving it on the following Tuesday. Purchased it to be used as a fridge for sodas and water at the office.

The fridge was double boxed, it's own box + an outside box and a half inch layer of styrofoam. No damage upon removing it from the box. The door is slightly crooked on the front, but still seals fine, no issues or complaints there.

Considering the other reviews say this doesn't get that cold, we cranked it up max and froze a portion of the sodas. We currently are still playing with the knob to get what we want, but it gets quite cold.

As others have said, the spacing between the bars on the shelves are a little goofy, so sometimes the sodas tilt over a bit. Some of the space is awkward, so it's difficult to keep stuff organized, since we have 9 or 10 different soda types and water in it. Looks like we're keeping about 80 cans in it now.

The light on the inside is essentially useless. It basically only illuminates the very top shelf and the rest is left in the dark.

product_title: LG 3.6 CF FRONT LOAD WASHER DRYER COMBO
review_headline: Fantastic laundry option for the space-challenged
review_body:
When we bought our condo, the laundry hookups were in a (very) small kitchen, with space for a stacked washer/dryer and no space for any food storage. A coworker recommended the LG all-in-one washer/dryers to save space, so we did our research and ultimately bought this model. Since we were able to fit it in the nook for a stacked washer/dryer, we put a butcherblock counter on top, and shelves above, and have our microwave and pantry in the same space.

PROS:

+Cleans clothes well, with lots of options for wash/dry settings.
+No need to move clothes from washer to dryer. (We typically put laundry in before we go to bed, and have clean clothes when we wake up.)
+Gentle on clothes. I wash my nice work clothes, including \\"lay flat to dry\\" sweaters on Cold and the regular dry setting, and they come out beautifully without shrinkage.
+Fairly quiet. Our bedroom is located above the washer, and though we sometimes hear the water pump kick on/off (the loudest part of the cycle), it never disrupts our sleep.
+Energy efficient. Our water bills and electric bills are generally very low, even when we have done a LOT of laundry.
+Ventless dryer. The previous owners of our house had the vent line for the dryer run horribly wrong, and it was a fire hazard. It would have cost us several hundred dollars to fix it.

CONS:

-Clothes don't come out toasty warm. (They feel slightly damp, but are dry when you shake them out/fold them.)
-Can only handle small to medium-sized loads. (Clothes dry best when the tub is about half-full, to give room for air to circulate when drying.)
-Long dry cycle; we generally do the 120-minute dry cycle for all of our loads, which means that the total wash/dry time is 3 hours.
-No lint filter. We have 3 cats and the cat hair gets trapped/stuck to the rubber seal on the door, which is annoying to clean out.

Overall, this washer/dryer perfectly suits our needs and works very well for us (two large-sized adults with lots of laundry). It is great to be able to put laundry in before we go to bed, and wake up to clean clothes. It has also freed up valuable space in our small kitchen, and eliminated the need for costly repairs to the existing dryer vent line in our condo.nd works very well for us (two large-sized adults with lots of laundry). It is great to be able to put laundry in before we go to bed, and wake up to clean clothes. product_title: Danby Silhouette Bottle Beverage Center
review_headline: WARNING - DON"T BUY THE DANBY FRIDGE UNIT, TERRIBLE CHINA MADE PRODUCT, HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE
review_body:

review_body:

Pros:

Cons:

product_title: Sunpentown WC-20TL ThermoElectric with Touch Sensitive Controls 20-Bottle Wine Cooler

product_title: Samsung RF4289 28 Cubic Foot French Door Refrigerator with 4 Doors, Integrated Water & Ice, and,
review_body:

Pros
-Definite wow factor - most of the guests that see the fridge are impressed with the technology
-Middle tray makes access to deli meats/cheese , soda etc very convenient. Sliding divider bar keeps item organized.
-Bright interior lights, well designed shelves and trays
-LCD is a great way to pass info. (esp. the calendar function since it syncs with my Google calendar and my wife's)

Cons
-Weak WiFi reception. My router is on the opposite side of the house, but I believe I should have better signal. (my PS3 gets excellent reception and is farther away.) I'm assuming I can remedy the situation with a simple wifi signal booster.
-Android operating system will crash after every 2-3 months requiring fridge to be unplugged and re plugged in.

At the time, this fridge was cheaper than the fridge without the LCD and the 4th door, so I bought the 3 yr extra warranty, an appliance surge protector(since it has circuit board), and still saved a few hundred compared to the lower model. I also took notice that a lot of the reviews on Amazon were the same people spamming angry reviews at the entire line of Samsung fridges and not any one fridge in general. review_headline: Do NOT Buy Any Amana/Whirlpool--Customer Service Stinks
review_body: I bought this washing machine a few months from an Amana dealer and it has never given me warm water. Amana/Whirlpool and their technicians is telling me that the temperature of the weather outside has an impact on whether or not I get warm water. My normal time of washing is early in the morning or late at night when the weather is very cool (sometimes, almost cold). I can get very hot on the hot setting and very cold on the cold setting but my warm water is the same temperature of the cold water. They're telling me that I won't get any warm water until winter time when the weather is colder which to me is totally ridiculous...I should be able to get warm water anytime. If the water valve is that sensitive to hot, it should also be that sensitive to cool but they're telling me that only hot weather affect it. My take is that the temperature of the water would be the determing factor as it passes through the water valve, not what the weather temperature is outside. I know that even in a hot hose that sits directly in the heat of the day that once I turn on cold water, the hose cools off significantly...I do wash my car from time to time in the heat of the day. Thus far, Amana/Whirlpool have virtually told me they aren't going to do anything to fix it, they aren't going to replace it and they aren't going to give me a refund although one of their technical shops have told me I have a malfunctioning water valve. Amana/Whirlpool has refused to even replace the valve which I and one of their technicians have said is the problem. Of course, this is a good thing for me because I had held them in such high esteem that I had an Amana/Whirlpool Dryer, Refrigerator and Freezer on my list but, needless to say, I have scratched everything Amana/Whirlpool from my list. I'm one step away from throwing this washing machine in the trash and buying some other brand that works. Their customer service is at a total zero and they don't seem to care whether the customer is satisfied with their products or not!!! Do NOT waste your time or money with these people or their products is my recommendation. You will be sorry if you do!!!

product_title: NewAir AW-210ED Streamline 21 Bottle Dual Zone Thermoelectric Wine Cooler, Black
review_headline: Looks nice, but runs on the noisy side
review_body:
The NewAir came neatly packaged in a large box with plenty of styrofoam padding. Although other reviews noted broken buttons, my unit arrived in nearly pristine condition. There was a minor aesthetic issue with some stainless steel trim appearing slightly warped on the bottom.

The unit looks high end with a combination of a stainless steel exterior and wooden shelving. Blue LED lights add to this appearance. The cooler is man portable, thanks to a lightweight metal rear panel and a grab handle on the bottom.

Unfortunately, noisy operation merited the loss of 1.5 stars. The cooler was very loud, moreso since walls of the unit are thin and there is a vent near the fan. It was definitely louder than my refrigerator, so I had to move it to a different location to seal off some of the noise. The bottom level of the cooler only reached 54 degrees even though the setpoint indicated 50 degrees. While this is sufficient for most beverages, it doesn't work well if you like to store beer (but let's face it, beer should really go into a cheap cooler with ice cubes.) Lastly, the wooden shelves did not slide out as smoothly as I expected.

I can't comment on reliability just yet, but so far no problems with usage.

review_body:

product_title: Broan 36W in. QT Under Cabinet Range Hood
review_headline: Motor hums, light bulb diffuser rattles
review_body:
It's an inexpensive range hood, and you get what you pay for. It's not awful, but not great either.

For use with a ducted exhaust, scored panels must be removed but the \\"perforations\\" are very strong, I had to use a Dremel and a cutting wheel to cut them free. Tinsnips might also work, but don't plan on removing these with bare hands.

No matter what speed is selected, even the slowest, the motor has a loud hum.

On higher fan speeds, the plastic diffuser that covers up the light bulbs rattles like crazy. If you put your hand on the diffuser the rattle goes away, so you can either wedge something in there to hold it tight or just throw away the diffuser.

Unless I'm missing something, the metal mesh protecting the fan from grease splatters etc seems to require a butter knife to remove.

Other than these issues, it works well. Moves plenty of air, the sheet metal is sturdy, and the rest of the build quality seems adequate.

product_title: FFBM921PS Bottom Mount Frost Free 9.2 Cu. Ft. Total Capacity Adjustable / Removable Shelving and Glass Shelves in the Refrigerator Section: Black with Platinum Freezer /
review_body: This refrigerator is a very beautiful refrigerator for an apartment. I own a large home and my kitchen is very large. I was not satisfied. It was too small, too short. product_title: Danby DDW1899WP 8 Place Setting Portable Dishwasher - White
review_body:
I bought this to help with the chores around the house, and its been a pretty decent machine. Cleans well and dishes are nice and shiny. Of course you want to scrape some of the food off, but unless something is really sticking hard to the dish, it'll most likely come off.

Things that could be improved? Maybe someone can correct me, but the machine isn't as quiet as I thought. There is a 'drrrrrk' sound every second, which is most likely water hitting the walls of the machine. On one hand I'm glad the water is strong enough to make that sound(cleaner dishes!) but on the other hand, yeah it could be quiet.

Also, the hoses are a bit short, but good news, you can fix this! Go to your local plumbing or hardware store, and look for a washing machine connector and a rubber outlet hose. Show the hardware guy your dishwasher faucet adapter, and tell them you want to connect your sink water tap to the mouth of the washing machine connector, and the end to the faucet adapter.

Buy some plumbing tape.and duct tape, buy the parts needed to connect the hoses. Come home and put them together. Duct tape the rubber outlet hose to the bottom of the faucet adapter.

Voila! Now you don't have to roll your dishwasher up to the sink every time!

product_title: Panda Small Mini Counter Top Portable Compact Washer Washing Machine 5.5-10lbs
review_headline: Excellent service, Malfunctioning and flimsy product

Quality of the product itself:

The plastic is thin and flimsy, not to mention that it is not even spinning, just like what the other reviewer had stated in his/her one star review. Having lived in Asia for many years, I can venture a guess how much this product REALLY is worth... sadly, I have to say, this thing is WAY overpriced. The margins are HIGH!!!
2) As shown in the pictures, there were cracks and \\"fractures\\" all over the machine, possibly due to damage during delivery. There are also leakages everywhere, which I honestly believe that it could be a safety hazard if the water goes into the motor and electric wires, and apparently was evident after we unscrewed the thing.
3) As an attempt to reconstruct this damaged product since it's already broken anyway, we took it apart and played with it. We ended up using the glue gun to repair the leakages and fix the motor belt so that it is aligned with the spinning wheel - right now we are giving it a test run as I am typing this. Will see if it works without flooding the bathroom.

Packaging:
1) There is no bubble wrap or any kind of protective layers of packaging other than a thin paper box which is what it comes in with. I am positive that this contributes to the several areas of damage to the machine, and that's truly a pity. I have initially posted several pictures demonstrating the cracks and damages, but was later contacted by the seller, asking me to remove them. Taking into the consideration that the majority of the buyers seemed to have a great experience with this machine, I honored her request and took the pictures off. Email me privately if you are interested in seeing those pictures.

Seller:
1) The seller is certainly worth complimenting. A representative, Christine emailed me back almost 5 minutes later when I first asked for a replacement. Prompt feedback, good customer service, and agreed to give me a full refund for the damaged product. At least the seller is willing to work with the customers and provide the help needed.

product_title: Miele : W3033 24 Front Load Washer - White [German Engineering - Built to Last]
review_headline: Worst Washing Machine I have ever owned
review_body: I would never purchase a Miele washing machine again.  We have an older model and we have had continuous problems with it.  I have never owned an appliance that requires so much service.

product_title: Haier Portable Compact Washing Machine - XQJ5031
review_body: THIS WASHER HOLDS MORE THAN I THOUGHT IT WOULD. ITS QUIET, WASHES EVERYTHING CLEAN, SPINS OUT 99% OF THE WATER. product_title: Frigidaire 131763202 Door Latch and Switch Assembly for Front Loading Frigidaire & Kenmore Washers
review_body: Product arrived quickly, undamaged, and as described.  The only issues were from my own limited knowledge of installation, and the fact that this is not an OEM part, so it is usable on multiple brands, which means it has a few extra connection points compared to the old part.

product_title: Samsung DV5451AGW
review_headline: Does not dry completly, shuts down
review_body: I purchased this dryer, along with the washer, from a store less than a month ago.  The dryer shuts down 2/3 of the time with a error of \\"hE\\".  Samsung has been notified, said they would send someone out but no one showed up.  When the error appears I have to wait over night and try and finish the next morning.  When it does complete the cycle, the clothes still feel a little damp if they are in the center of the load.  I only dry one load of washed clothes at a time so I don't overload the dryer.  The dryer duct and venting was cleaned when this dryer was installed and there was no problems with the previous dryer.  I think the worse part is that Samsung refuses to respond to a vaild claim and fix this, the dryer is less than a month old.  I tried posting a review on the Samsung site but they refuse to post it, no reason given.  Samsng refused to discuss why they will not fix this issue.

product_title: Samsung RF4287 28 Cubic Foot French Door Refrigerator with 4 Doors and Integrated Water & Ice,
review_body:
Had my Samsung RF487HARS about 18 months now. It worked great until the other night. Good thing I came to the kitchen before going up to bed. The kitchen floor was flooded and water was pouring out of the ice maker. I shut off the water supply and got the water up off the floor then started to dry out the inside of the refrigerator. I noticed the lights were off even with doors open and the compressor was not running. I pressed the control panel display and an error message came up...\\"PC-ER\\" I think.
Then I remembered I saw an error message once when I first installed the refrigerator and fiddled with the controls. I solved it then by unplugging the unit and plugging it back in, just like a cable box. So I tried that this time and the refrigerator started working just fine again. Problem is, I don't trust leaving the water on to the refrigerator any more. I only bought a new refrigerator because my old one had no ice or water dispenser.
Evidently the computer went out and left the ice maker filler valve open. Samsung support said I should have left the error code displayed for a tech to see, but I was panicked and didn't want to lose all my food. Now there is no way to know what's wrong until it happens again they said.
You would think Samsung could have designed the unit so a computer problem wouldn't result in a flood. Good thing they don't design spacecraft or airliners....

product_title: AE-SELECT WHIRLPOOL / Kenmore Ice Maker Icemaker OEM Original Part: 2198597
review_body: This is the same as the OEM inthe Kenmore refrigerator/freezer.  This is okay - but has the same ejection problems as the OEM ice maker and sometimes jams up, which is what caused the plastic to break on the OEM.  I will see how long it lasts and would have bought another if there was one available for my side by side Kenmore.

product_title: Bosch WAS24460UCAxxis 2.2 Cu. Ft. White Stackable Front Load Washer - Energy Star
review_headline: Happy with it for 5 years now
review_body:
I got the Bosch Axxis plus washer and dryer in Jan 2009. Selected this model because I really wanted a front-loader but there were space considerations, and had to have it special-ordered (from Lowe's). Also, I only have one 220V outlet, but the dryer plugs into the washer so that wasn't an issue.

I've been very happy with my choice - it washes really well, has all the options I've ever needed and it's not loud. I like to pull the detergent drawer after each wash so that it dries well and I also use a microfiber cloth to wipe the gasket folds after use. After 5 years of use the gasket is as good as new.

I also don't share the load considerations mentioned in another review, for whites it handles a normal size load just fine - i.e. king size bed sheets, pillow cases, and 4-5 midsize towels. Washing just 2 pairs of jeans for me would be an inefficient use of water.

product_title: Electrolux EW30EW55G 30" Electric Single Wall Oven with PerfectConvect Convection and Wave Touch Cont,
review_body: I love it.  A little more complicated than i'd like but i'm sure i'll figure it out as i use it more.  the fan noise isn't bad but does stay on a while to cool down after the oven is off.  this doesn't bother me at all.  over all really happy with the oven.

product_title: SPT Countertop Dishwasher
review_headline: It is everything it was said to be. I just Love it. .
review_body: It is perfect for 2 adults and a dog.It has given me more time to do other things,i.e. to enjoy life.

product_title: Water Sentinel WSL-3 Water Filter Replaces LT700P, ADQ36006101, ADQ36006101-S, ADQ36006101S, ADQ36006102, ADQ36006102-S, ADQ36006102S, 048231783705, ADQ36006101, 9690, 46-9690, LA07, 3 Pack

review_body: This dishwasher was installed about a year and a half ago and now all the water remains in the dishwasher. (From the beginning there was often a terrible smell after the cycle finished) I called customer service and it apparently needs a new pump which would be covered under a 2 year warranty except that you have to pay for the factory repair service to be covered by the warranty. Their service is $99 for the first 18 minutes and then $120 an hour after that. We clean the dishes well before loading the dishwasher and we travel a lot so it does not have heavy use. It does have some good features (quiet, cleans well) but we are probably going to have to spend about $200 to get the pump changed which doesn't seem right since we paid over $800 for it.  Will never buy another Bosch again.

product_title: Bosch 700 Series Evolution 30" Self-Cleaning Freestanding Range With Warming Drawer
review_body: I like the combination gas range/electric oven. It has 4 different size burners which is very efficient and the stainless is easy to clean. The grill topping the burners will also support my canning kettle during the season.  Oven bakes bread and cookies....so far....evenly and haven't even used the convection feature. The next test will be how long it lasts....time will tell.

product_title: Whirlpool Dishwasher Heater Element W10134009 8572861 8563007
review_body:
Item was exactly as shown online and replaced our old heater element very well.
Shipping and handling was done as planned.
We installed it ourselves and our dishwasher works perfect again!

product_title: Avanti WD31EC Table Top Thermoelectric Water Cooler
review_body: The Avanti table top dispenser is nice looking but that is it. It appealed to me because I could lift a two or three gallon jug of water, however it doesn't keep water cold and if it did the manual states that it only cools 20 oz at a time, and then you have to wait for an hour to get cold water again. I can't remark on the hot water because I haven't used it. Unless you want a place to store your water bottle and then fill and refrigerate the water don't waste your money. I wonder how much electricity it uses. There is a normal and an energy saving mode feature, but I am about to pull the plug so I may never know.

product_title: NewAir AW-210ED Streamline 21 Bottle Dual Zone Thermoelectric Wine Cooler, Black
review_body:
I love this unit, at the time of the purchase I liked it because the lower part is for the reds and I was drinking more reds. Love the dual zone, the light is great to find what you want before opening the door, great piece in any room. It does run alot or all the time, it sounds like a computer fan so it is not loud to the point of being a problem I have mine in the dining room and has never been an issue, most days we do not even notice it running. Bought March 2010

Update 4/27/11 - the upper cooler keeps kicking in and out and not keeping temp anymore. The bottom is still working for now just waiting for that one to stop.

Update 8/5/12 - Both upper and lower lose their temp and go all the way up, I need to use canned air to blow it out and it seems to cool once again, not alot of dust comes out but just seems enough to mess with it. Yes it still kicks in/out but it is still working overall. Would I buy this again probably not.

product_title: Bosch HBL5450UC500 30" Stainless Steel Electric Single Wall Oven - Convection
review_body: Bosch has lots of computer board problems with their ovens and no warranty support, be prepared to pay up front for the product and keep paying in repairs

product_title: Washing Machine Hose (PBLSPWE601212)
review_body:
I haven't changed the rubber hoses on our washer since we purchased it about 10 years ago and figured it was about time. After reviewing and comparing many hoses it looked like this one was one of the best. I definitely made a good choice.

When you open the package and look/feel where the hose meets the connector you can appreciate the quality. These are many times better than your plain rubber hoses. The angled connector for the back of the washer means you don't have to bend it, just point in the direction you want the hose to go. There's not much more to say - you connect it, it works. I suspect it will last longer than the rubber ones it replaced.

Lastly, purchase the hoses from Ace. Though it would appear the price is a few cents higher if you add the shipping cost, that's only if you're buying just one. For the second one, the additional shipping is only about 70 cents more - not double the shipping amount shown. Since most people will be buying two at a time, the total cost from Ace is a few dollars less expensive than the other merchants.

product_title: Dometic Microwave Glass Turntable Plate / Tray 13 1/2" A019
review_body: I found this quickly when searching for the correct microwave plate that had accidentally come out of the microwave and fell on the floor and broke.  The price was very competitive, too.

review_body: I did some research and along with the reviews on Amazon decided upon this wine cooler-and it has been a great choice! my only negative comment would be if you have a wine bottle that has dimensions slightly off from a normal size bottle it won't fit into the rack.The cooler holds its temp,and the bottles are easily seen from outside

product_title: Whirlpool WTW5600XW Cabrio 3.6 Cu. Ft. White Top Load Washer - Energy Star
review_headline: Biggest Appliance Purchase Mistake that I have ever made!!
review_body:
We bought this machine to replace a 10 year old Kenmore and have now owned it over a year. Excited about purchasing a high efficiency machine that would save on energy and the environment. This washer has been nothing but a headache. It can only handle small loads w/ no problem. Every time I try to wash sheets, towels or fill it over halfway w/ clothes the machine starts itself over and over again b/c it becomes unbalanced constantly. Jeans? Forget about it! product_title: Electrolux EI26SS55GS 25.9 cu. ft. Side by Side Refrigerator w/IQ-Touch - Stainless Steel
review_headline: The worst appliance I have ever owned.
review_body: This is worst appliance I have ever owned. The 15 year old $700 refrigerator I have in my garage is of higher quality and performance than this one. Please do not anyone else waste their money on an Electrolux refrigerator. The display has been replaced 3 times and is now broken again. The water and ice dispenser are broken - just snapped off one day. And now, it powers off for no reason at random times and then the power fail beeping goes off. When I try to power it back on, it takes 15 minutes to kick back on - with the beeping going off the entire time. None of the display keys work (i.e mute sounds or on/off, factory default). It often happens at night or when we are not home so we end up losing our food because it has defrosted or we are nervous - not knowing how long it was down. I have called Electrolux at least 8 times over the years about these issues and they just tell me it is not under warranty and they are not obligated to do anything. They told me today they only have a record of 3 calls from me ... I have called them 3 times just in the last 2 weeks. Horrible product, horrible customer service and will not stand behind their shoddy equipment. I NEVER review products but I hope that this will prevent anyone else from buying this money pit.  I would never buy another Electrolux product.

product_title: Frigidaire Gallery Stainless Steel 4 Piece Appliance Package with French Door Refrigerator #210
review_body: We held our breath to purchase appliances online.  The seller is great but the fridge not so much.  The Icemaker wasn't working out of the box, so under a year's warranty we had someone come to fix it.  They are here right at this moment "fixing" it for a second time.  The first visit they replaced the entire icemaker, but has still only produce like 8 cubes in two days.  Then soon after icemaker replacement our fridge is making a horrid buzzing sound.  I am not sure if it is the icemaker of the fridge itself.  Apparently the evaporator is frosted over and the fan blade is smacking the ice making a bad sound. Other than the icemaker/ frosting problems the fridge is just okay.  There doesn't seem to much more space in the French door fridge from a standard fridge, the freezer seems to be much bigger than a standard freezer though.  The shelves are typical cheap plastic.  The right door has a large magnet on the side that often gets caught between the doors when closing.  We were also expecting a made in America fridge, not the case, it is made in Mexico.  If I were to buy again I'd go for a single door fridge on top w/ single freezer on the bottom.  I prefer the fridge on top to reduce bending down.  I don't know if I'd go for an Icemaker though.  It seems as though Frigidaire, also known as Electrolux, the global company doesn't produce very good icemakers, but I've know other brands to produce bad icemakers as well such as whirlpool.  Other appliances in the package:  So far so good.  Dishwasher: has been a big upgrade over our last cheapo run of the mill.  It has three levels of cleaning, a spinner at the bottom, top and middle.  It cleans well and has lots of space for dishes.  Stove/oven:  I like the flat surface, no problems here.  Microwave: No problems, works like a microwave should.  Update:  We move houses 2 years ago and ended up selling these appliance with the house, thank God.  In out new home we purchased a Kenmore Elite appliance set through Sears:  French door fridge with ice maker that works like a charm and Dishwasher that washes better, all for about the same price.  Do not buy Frigidaire/ Electrolux.

product_title: Electrolux EW27EW65GS Wave-Touch 27" Stainless Steel Electric Double Wall Oven - Convection
review_body:
This refrigerator is priced like a Rolls-Royce but runs like a Yugo. We are on our second one now. On the first, the ice maker stopped working and our extended warranty company was unable to fix it. Apparently there was a design flaw which required a total replacement. We were offered either a replacement Electrolux, or a check for substantially less than the original purchase price. We opted for a replacement and boy do I regret it. The door on the new one doesn't close properly and just this morning the water dispenser stopped working. Searching the web I find that a common issue is that the water line actually freezes. Seriously? Done with Electrolux forever. I can't believe that in 2013 I have to spend so much time thinking about a freakin' refrigerator.

The positive reviews of this device are the anomaly. Even a broken clock is right twice a day and I'm sure there are people who are perfectly happy with their purchase. But they are the fortunate exceptions. Save yourself a pile of hassles (and money) - and don't buy this refrigerator.

product_title: SPT Countertop Dishwasher
review_body:
I got my dishwasher a couple months ago. Initially easy to set up. I was able to set it up myself without my husband's help. The only problem I have is that it does have a slow leak from the back hose where it connects to the machine. I tighten it all the way but it still leaks. I contacted the manufacturer and they were UNBELIEVABLY helpful. I spoke with LEWIS from Sun Pen Town (SPT) several times. They sent me new parts right away. One down and three to go -- at least we'll know exactly what to do if and when the other burners develop problems.

product_title: GE GSHF6PGY Energy Star 25.8 Cu. Ft. Side-By-Side Refrigerator with 3 Spill Proof Glass Shelves,
review_body: I am a little biased as a relative helps make GE motors.  I have owned this for 5 months now.  It replaced a used Frigidaire I had for a short time, which was 14 years old.  It really replaced a very old, very small top freezer refrigerator I had for 16 years.    The GE is quiet.  The compressor makes little noise.  It is on the wall opposite our bedroom.  I do not hear it in the bedroom.  It's not an annoying noise.  It is just barely audible in the kitchen.      This is real stainless.  Keeping it fingerprint clean is a chore with young kids.  We just let it go and clean it on the weekend.  Takes about 10 minutes or so using stainless cleaner to make it sharp again.  Without kids this would probably not be an issue.    The water maker and ice maker work very well.  The filter gives the water a good taste.      The layout of the compartments is excellent for our needs, as you can see by the pictures.  It has more than enough room for our use.    If we overload the freezer, the door will sometimes not completely close.  The door open sensor does not always sense this.  This results in ice build up inside the freezer, and condensation on the outside.   Don't overload the freezer and this doesn't happen.    We got an excellent deal on this model.  I feel we got a great fridge for the money.

product_title: Kenmore LAUNDRY CENTER Washer Motor Belt 131686100
review_body: Not the exact part i needed, but other manufacturer's parts are just as good. Fit like a glove. Worth it to anyone who doesn't want to pay out the nose for a repairman.

product_title: Whirlpool GZ25FSRXYY
review_headline: I really want to give 5 stars...
review_body:
I love this refridgerator. I really wanted to give it 5 stars, but some minor issues forced me to give it 4 stars.

It looks beautiful and was very easy to install. Like most stainless steel(SS) refridgerators, only the front is SS. The sides are gray. Have you ever noticed most people don't have magnets on their SS appliances? I learned the hard way that magnets easily scratch the surface.

My favorite part of the fridge is the filtered water. The water and ice cubes taste great! Ice cubes in my last fridge had a funny taste. I have replaced the filter once, when the built in indicator told me to, and it was very easy to access inside the top right of the fridge. This brings me to my first complaint. After replacing the filter, the water dispenser started making a slight screaching noise when dispensing water. Fortunately, it went away after about a month. Perhaps it was a little air in the line.

My second complaint is a bigger deal. The handle on the bottom freezer has come off into my hand at least 5 times. I tried firmly clicking it into place with a good amount of force when replacing it, but it still came off. I took the handle locking mechanisms apart and switched it with the mechanisms from one of the french door handles. The french door handle is secured by pushing down, so I figured this door would be hard to pull off, even if the locking system was not working perfectly. I have had no problems with either door since making the switch.

My last fridge had one big door and was located in a high traffic area. The french drawers of this fridge do not block the passage from my kitchen to my family room like my previous fridge. Also, I wasn't sure if I would like the middle drawer, but have found vegetables in this drawer last longer then my previous fridge's vegetable containers. My previous fridge did not have the water and ice dispenser. I find myself drinking a lot more water since the dispenser is so easy to use andthe water tastes so good.

I highly recommend this fridge and really wanted to give it 5 stars. The handle flying off in my hand and the minor problems with the water dispenser forced me to mark it down. If I didn't have to come up with my own fix for the handle, I would of given it 5 stars.

product_title: Centrifugal Clothes Portable Spin Dryer
review_headline: Don't hesitate to get Spin Dryer
review_body: I waited 6 months after getting the Haier 120v dryer before purchasing the Spin Dryer. Don't wait that long. As others have commented, it cuts the drying time down to 30 minutes. The larger capacity Spin Dryer allows me to do practically all my washing at home, from pants to kingsize sheets. The only thing I cannot put in the Spin Dryer is the kingsize bedspread.     When spin drying be careful balancing the various weights - if the Spin Dryer is still wobbling after 10 seconds, stop, open and just redistribute items - close, start and it will rebalance. Do not put items directly into Spin Dryer without trying to remove some water - unwrung items will start to leak out water before spinning begins, and there's from 2x-3x the amount of water to collect. Just wring (or squeeze) clothes to remove water. This collects about 4 cups of water.     Washing and drying 1 load of clothing takes about 45 minutes. Nothing beats the convenience of being able to do laundry when I want, whenever I want. The cost of the machine pays for itself in less than 1 year taking into account $5/week * 52 weeks in coin operated facility. Line dried sheets (takes about 4 hours to dry). Using the Haier dryer to remove wrinkles and give clothings fluffiness. Items line dried take about 1-2 hours to completely dry.    For one person, using the Spin Dryer is convenient. If more than one, need to weight the convenience of doing laundry in home, but may take longer, against convenience of the larger, automatic washing machine in coin laundry. There are no hookups to be concerned about. As long as you stay with the Spin Dryer when it begins spinning, monitor the water being extracted and have a container large enough to collect, you should have no problem with the Spin Dryer. Extracting takes about 1-3 minutes, the bulk of the water is removed in the first minute, and then there's a slow stream about 1 minute, and then a slow trickle the 3 minute. Letting items Spin Dry more than 2 minutes produces more wrinkles in the items (especially sheets).    To decrease the wear on the Spin Dryer, I only use it after I have rinsed the items. I hope to have several years of use with the Spin Dryer - only time will tell.

product_title: Samsung SMH8165B 1.6 cu. ft. 1000 Watt Over-the-Range Microwave - Black
review_body:
This is one of very few purchases I didn't do my homework on, but I bought mine at Best Buy on sale and figured a microwave is a microwave. I got the dreaded \\"SE\\" error message about a year and a half after purchase. We had just got through cleaning the keyboard when it started beeping and showing message. In fairness.....when it worked...it worked great. And the research showed to be careful of cleaners, etc. But after reading the other reviews, I agree that Samsung could do better with the keypad design. I didn't even try to call them after reading the other comments.
There are some useful links on the web concerning this problem. I was able to dry out any moisture from the keypad with a hairdryer. I also ordered a new membrane keypad...just in case. I also sealed up some openings behind the keypad to minimize any moisture getting into the membrane. So far......it's working. It's just aggravating to have to spend time to track down something when the mfg could make right on it.
